primitives.name: Governed Workflow Registry
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Workflow Automation Coordinator Implemented a governed workflow registry and run planner under `apps/web/lib/workflows`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'W': 'set of workflows, dimensionless', 'R': 'registry function, W → {0,1}', 'T': 'time, seconds'}
primitives.assumptions: Workflows are discrete-time Markov processes with finite state spaces; registry enforces deterministic transition rules.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Registry fails when R(w) = 0 for active w ∈ W; leads to undefined behavior in run planning.

layer2.mapping: Registry function R(w) mirrors GSI's probabilistic model selection; both map inputs to structured outputs via constraint satisfaction.
layer2.telemetry: Registry compliance rate across all active workflows.

primitives.name: Safety Workflow Gates
primitives.verbatim_quote: Film Room Workflow ## Safety Workflow gates block publish/send/spend/deploy/scrape/public-enable/model-weight changes.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G': 'set of safety gates, dimensionless', 'S': 'state vector, dimensionless', 'B': 'block condition, {0,1}'}
primitives.assumptions: Each gate G_i is a binary predicate over S; B = 1 iff any G_i(S) = 1.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Gate failure occurs when B = 0 despite required blocking; causes unauthorized state transitions.

layer2.mapping: Safety gates act as kernel constraints in GSE's state-transition graph; they define forbidden subgraphs in the causal lattice.
layer2.telemetry: Number of blocked transitions per time window.

primitives.name: Intelligence Workflow Automaton
primitives.verbatim_quote: Daily Intelligence Brief 2. Picks Intelligence Workflow 3. Market Intelligence Workflow 4. Settlement Workflow 5. Calibration
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I_w': 'intelligent process, dimensionless', 'P_w': 'prediction function, I_w → ℝ', 'U_w': 'utility function, I_w → ℝ'}
primitives.assumptions: Each workflow I_w evolves according to a stochastic policy π_w; U_w is bounded and measurable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Workflow divergence when P_w ≠ E[U_w]; leads to misalignment between predictions and outcomes.
